card.name: First letter of t.i.d. and b.i.d.
card.fires_on: The first letter (t or b) of dosing-frequency abbreviations like t.i.d. and b.i.d., right after a dose amount such as 50 mg. Also the unit piece before a slash in rates such as mg/kg/hour.
